description: Attempt to install the Agent Plugins bundle into Antigravity CLI from a local path.
why: ADR-0045 recorded Antigravity's manifest schema as closed and DIFFERENT from the Agent Plugins one, and its file shapes as unspecified. This scenario exists to turn that into a measurement: if `agy plugin install` accepts the bundle, the deferred variant is unnecessary; if it rejects it, the rejection message is the spec. SKIPPED with reason when the CLI is absent.

steps.why: antigravity.google/docs/cli/plugins: `agy plugin install /path/to/local/plugin`. Either outcome is information; the stderr is captured in the report.
